name: Recipe Manager
short_desc: Self-hosted recipe library with URL import
description: A minimal recipe manager with per-user accounts, URL import from major French and English recipe sites, full-text search, tagging, and Android share-to-import via PWA.
author: dvidbruhm

form_fields.label: Session secret (used to sign login cookies)
Public base URL (used in password-reset emails, e.g. https://recipes.example.com)
SMTP port (optional; defaults to 587, or 465 if SMTP_SECURE=true)
SMTP username (optional; enables SMTP AUTH when set with SMTP_PASS)
SMTP implicit TLS (use port 465; otherwise opportunistic STARTTLS)
